actions.findings:
Prebiotic evolution requires examining whether heritability and compositional stability could precede template-based replication. [peer-21edf144b7e5b0cbb2af7775]

Thermodynamic persistence and stoichiometric constraints govern the emergence of natural selection in prebiotic reaction networks. [peer-25677e31a1521e0a7677b4f1]
actions.limitations: Models rely on theoretical error thresholds and idealized system-environment assumptions without comprehensive experimental verification across all non-conservative reaction regimes.
